author: Muhannadx1991
quote:
I have no desire to be a part of supporting this game. I’ve only played it for an hour, and it is absolutely terrible. **** this bad somehow earns a score of 99, then it will soon become the ruin of the entire gaming industry.
1-The gameplay is repetitive and lacks any real evolution; the changes are merely superficial—the kind of trivial details that only a failed critic would care about, as they have no actual impact on how the game plays. The gameplay itself is extremely shallow, remaining exactly the same as what we’ve come to expect from the series.
2-The handling of the characters in the story is extremely poor—it’s clear that the series' original writer has left. The dialogue is incredibly weak, and all of this happens within just one hour; it’s simply unacceptable.
3-This game has contributed to the destruction of game pricing standards. The developers act as if they are selling a polished product, yet it is far from polished—riddled with catastrophic technical flaws, narrative failures, and a lack of the gameplay innovation the series desperately needed. This franchise has now helped push the entire gaming world toward collapse.
